The World Organisation for Animal Health says wildfires are becoming an increasingly serious animal health emergency, leaving wildlife with burns, smoke inhalation, dehydration and other life-threatening injuries, while destroying the habitat they depend on for food and shelter. This year, Oregon shattered its previous record for a single wildfire season, with 2 million acres burned. 

Al Jazeera's Eva McKend reports from Washington.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan have committed to closer military cooperation in a joint defence agreement modelled on NATO's Article 5, under which an attack on one member is considered an attack on all. The deal comes as regional countries increasingly look to each other for security following Israel's war on Gaza, its strikes on several countries in the region, and the renewed conflict with Iran. For Turkiye, which already fields NATO's second-largest army and one of the world's fastest-growing defence industries, the pact is a major strategic gain, expanding its reach into the Gulf and South Asia and opening access to new financial resources through a joint weapons programme. But the real test, Al Jazeera's Resul Serdar reports from Ankara, will come if a member is actually attacked — determining whether the agreement becomes a genuine regional security architecture or remains just a political declaration.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Typhoon Dolphin, one of the most powerful storms of the year, is crossing Japan's Okinawa prefecture and the Ryukyu Islands with winds around 165km/h and gusts near 200km/h — equivalent to a category 2 hurricane. Evacuation orders have been issued for around 260,000 people, flights have been cancelled, and dangerous waves, coastal flooding and intense rain are expected as the storm passes close to Japan's southern islands. Dolphin is forecast to weaken before reaching eastern China on Sunday evening, but will still bring destructive winds, torrential rain and rough seas. Though its peak winds have eased, the storm has grown larger and slower-moving, raising flood risk as parts of eastern China could see 250-400mm of rain within 24 hours of landfall. 

Al Jazeera's Everton Fox has the details.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
At least three inmates are dead, and more than 20 are injured after fighting broke out at several prisons across Sri Lanka, including Kuruwita Prison and Pallansena Open Prison, where inmates climbed onto the roof in protest over overcrowding and case delays. Officials suspect narcotics gangs were involved and are investigating whether the unrest was part of a coordinated campaign. The violence comes just weeks after an incident at Negombo prison killed 32 people, with 61 prisoners now facing charges over that attack. 

Al Jazeera's Minelle Fernandez reports from Colombo.
